sentence_embedding.pooling: attention-mask mean over last hidden state, including CLS/SEP; L2 normalized
sentence_embedding.notes: Use the documented sentence-embedding limit even though the underlying architecture supports more positions. Fail instead of truncating any poem.

stylometry.normalization: column population z-score then row L2 cosine; constant columns zeroed

fitting_scope: Whole fixed corpus for descriptive comparisons only. Refit TF-IDF and scaling within training folds for predictive evaluation.
